About Us

The State Scholarship Portal (SSP) – a unified platform
developed by Center for e-Governance, DPAR (e-
Governance), Government of Karnataka ensures
disbursement of Prematric & Postmatric Scholarship
under various schemes of Govt of Karnataka. SSP provides
a platform for receipt of online applications and disbursal
of scholarship by sponsoring departments through DBT to
the Aadhaar seeded bank account of the beneficiary.
